resources.string: Location sharing
Sharing your location
You\'re available, so nearby restaurants can see where you are. Tap to open the app.
Why we need your location in the background

While you\'re available, we use your location so nearby delivery orders can reach you, and the restaurant can see the delivery route — even when the app isn\'t open. We never use your location while you\'re unavailable.
Continue
Background location is off — trips only update while the app is open. Tap to fix this.
Open settings
Keep receiving orders while your screen is off
Some phone makers stop apps running in the background to save power. Follow these steps so you don\'t miss an order.
Allow background activity
Open %1$s settings
Done
Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO
Open Security app → Permissions → Autostart, and turn this app ON.
Go to Settings → Apps → Manage apps → this app → Battery saver, and choose \"No restrictions\".
Go to Settings → Apps → Permissions → Other permissions, and enable \"Display pop-up windows while running in background\".
OPPO / Realme
Go to Settings → Battery → this app, and turn off \"Sleep-time optimisation\".
Go to Settings → App management → this app → turn on \"Allow auto-start\" and \"Allow background running\".
vivo / iQOO
Go to i Manager → App manager → Autostart, and turn this app ON.
Go to Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management, and allow this app to run in the background.
Huawei
Go to Settings → Battery → App launch → this app, and switch it to \"Manage manually\", then turn ON Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
Go to Settings → Apps → this app → Battery, and choose \"Unrestricted\".
Lock this app in your recent-apps list so the system doesn\'t close it.
HONOR
Go to Settings → Battery → App launch → this app, and turn on \"Manage manually\" with all three switches enabled.
Lock this app in your recent-apps list so the system doesn\'t close it.
Samsung
Go to Settings → Apps → this app → Battery, and choose \"Unrestricted\".
Go to Settings → Battery and device care → Battery → Background usage limits, and remove this app from \"Sleeping apps\" / \"Deep sleeping apps\".
Your phone
Allow this app to run in the background using the button below.
